subtitles.text: *April 1945.* Three Soviet fronts stand on the Oder and Neisse, 60 km from *Berlin*
*16 April.* Zhukov attacks the *Seelow Heights*; Konev crosses the *Neisse*
After four days the heights fall, at a cost of over *30,000* Soviet dead
*20 April.* Rokossovsky crosses the lower Oder; Soviet guns *shell Berlin*
*24 April.* The German 9th Army is cut off in the *Halbe pocket*
*25 April.* Zhukov and Konev close the ring at *Ketzin*; US and Soviet troops meet at *Torgau*
Wenck's *12th Army* attacks toward Potsdam, but cannot break through
*30 April.* Soviet troops storm the *Reichstag*; Hitler kills himself in his bunker
*2 May.* General Weidling surrenders Berlin to Chuikov. The battle is over
